input.command:
set -e
rm -rf /tmp/skillhub-sysadmin-review
 git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Limax666/SkillHub.git /tmp/skillhub-sysadmin-review >/tmp/skillhub-clone.log 2>&1
cd /tmp/skillhub-sysadmin-review/System_Administration/old_version/jdrhyne_sysadmin-toolbox
printf '%s\n' '--- files ---'
find . -type f -maxdepth 3 -print -exec wc -c {} \;
printf '%s\n' '--- executable files ---'
find . -type f -perm /111 -print
printf '%s\n' '--- command/network/delete indicators ---'
grep -RInE '(curl|wget|nc |netcat|ssh |scp |rm -rf|mkfs|dd if=|shutdown|reboot|chmod 777|eval |base64 -d|/etc/shadow|authorized_keys|token|password|secret)' . || true
printf '%s\n' '--- git commit ---'
git -C /tmp/skillhub-sysadmin-review log -1 --format='%H%n%an <%ae>%n%ad%n%s' --date=iso-strict

d=$(mktemp -d /tmp/skillhub-sysadmin-review.XXXXXX) && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Limax666/SkillHub.git "$d" >/tmp/skillhub-clone.log 2>&1 && cd "$d/System_Administration/old_version/jdrhyne_sysadmin-toolbox" && printf '%s
' '--- files ---' && find . -type f -maxdepth 3 -print -exec wc -c {} \; && printf '%s
' '--- executable files ---' && find . -type f -perm /111 -print && printf '%s
' '--- indicators ---' && grep -RInE '(curl|wget|nc |netcat|ssh |scp |rm -rf|mkfs|dd if=|shutdown|reboot|chmod 777|eval |base64 -d|/etc/shadow|authorized_keys|token|password|secret)' . || true && printf '%s
' '--- git commit ---' && git -C "$d" log -1 --format='%H%n%an <%ae>%n%ad%n%s' --date=iso-strict && printf '%s
' "REVIEW_DIR=$d"
